title: Trait Consistency
goal: Choose the cleanest implementation for duplicating a struct using standard traits.
hints: Deriving Clone gives the struct a full clone method automatically.
You cannot move owned fields out of a borrowed reference.
explanation: Deriving `Clone` on `Config` automatically implements the `Clone` trait and allows calling `cfg.clone()`. Trying to move `cfg.endpoint` out of `&Config` fails with `E0507` because shared references cannot be moved. Calling `cfg.clone()` without deriving `Clone` fails with `E0599` because `Config` does not implement the trait.
